author: Robin_DD_J
body:
So I thought it was annoying to leave the server go to the hub and then find a new game when you only want to chamge nebula server exc. So my idea was you could change ( server of that type of gamemode ) when you press the paper ...

and you will get a server list off "The nebula servers only" 

( Pfft, What are you on about? Ofc that is all the servers nebula have.. ) 

This server list will only go for the servers on a type of game mode, so if it is Nebula it will only show nebula servers.
I think this will be usefull tho you don't have to go to the hub and then pick a new server again and again.

Thanks for reading.
